FIELDS.NAME: Precision Engineering & Surveying Solutions
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Senior Project Manager, Phone: (555) 987-6543, Email: john.smith@precisionengineering.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Precision Engineering & Surveying Solutions, we specialize in providing comprehensive engineering and surveying services, including geospatial analysis, land surveying, civil engineering design, and project management. Our operations encompass site assessments, topographic surveys, boundary determinations, and detailed engineering analysis to support various infrastructure projects. We prioritize safety and environmental compliance by adhering to local, state, and federal regulations, and we implement rigorous risk management protocols to ensure operational excellence. Our team consists of licensed professionals who are committed to ongoing education and training, utilizing modern technology and certified equipment to deliver high-quality results while minimizing exposure to hazards. With a clean claims history, we are dedicated to maintaining strong client relationships and advocating for sustainable practices in every project we undertake.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In April 2022, we experienced a minor equipment failure during a land surveying project, resulting in a loss of $2,500. The issue was promptly addressed, and the equipment was repaired without any further incidents. The status of this loss is closed, with all necessary corrective actions taken to prevent future occurrences.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Class B Vault, Grade 1, Fire Rated
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and dedicated watchpersons on-site during project execution.

FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Precision Engineering & Surveying Solutions is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our services are focused on engineering and surveying operations without engaging in these activities.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Precision Engineering & Surveying Solutions does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our focus remains on providing specialized engineering and surveying services without engaging in equipment rental activities.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Precision Engineering & Surveying Solutions has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. Our financial standing is stable and reflects solid risk management practices.

FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Precision Engineering & Surveying Solutions does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations focus on low-risk engineering and surveying services that prioritize safety and compliance with regulations.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Precision Engineering & Surveying Solutions has not experienced any past losses or claims related to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Precision Engineering & Surveying Solutions has no uncorrected fire code violations. We prioritize safety and compliance with all relevant regulations.
